title: Matrinium-based active pharmaceutical ingredient ionic liquids: chain length effect on micellization, bioactivity and thermodynamic behaviors
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,25758-25770
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA03216D, Paper
Open Access

Zhenning Yan, Mengmeng Xu, Huanhuan Lu
Biocompatible matrinium-based ionic liquids with fatty acid anions were prepared via an atom-economic approach, showing improved antimicrobial activity and cytotoxicity profiles for MatILs with longer anionic alkyl chains compared to matrine.
